title: Love - Love
overview: L0VE–L0VE is the remarkably engaging story of two brothers : Andy, who suffers from schizophrenia, and Jeff, an actor in search of success and meaning in his life. After the death of their grandmother, Andy's life is upended, as he's faced with the prospect of having to live in a group home. He's got other plans, however, intent on moving in with the father they haven't seen in years. And so, two brothers set out on a road trip to find their absentee father, a disgraced former professional tennis player who's now living in seclusion somewhere in the California desert.  First time feature film filmmaker Thomas Leisten Schneider has delivered a funny, sweet, heartfelt new take on the classic 'road trip' movie, featuring a charming performance by Haley Joel Osment, and career best work from Beck Bennett and Chris Elliott.
